Refrigerator backup power supplies

For keeping a refrigerator running during a power outage, the most practical options are portable battery power stations, battery backup systems with UPS functionality, and inverter generators.

A typical household refrigerator may use 100–250 watts while running, but its compressor can briefly require much more power when starting.

For a battery backup, I recommend looking for:

Capacity: 1,000–2,000 Wh or more

AC output: At least 1,000 W continuous, with adequate compressor startup surge capacity

Pure sine wave inverter: Better suited for refrigerator compressors

UPS/EPS functionality: Useful if you want automatic switchover when utility power fails
